BOOK ONE · LESSON 076

When did you ...?

你什么时候……？

A lesson on past-tense questions and answers with time phrases. Students listen to questions about past actions, then complete a time-phrase reference table (this/last/before-last week/month/year vs. a minute/hour/day/week/month/year ago). Fifteen illustrations (109-123) show people performing past-tense actions. Written exercises include rewriting present-tense sentences in the past and writing questions and answers with time cues. Workbook practice covers the simple past with irregular verbs in dialogues and personal questions about past experiences. Grammar exercises fill in past-tense forms and complete dialogues.

this month / last month / the month before last
this year / last year / the year before last

a minute ago / two minutes ago
an hour ago / five hours ago
a day ago / three days ago
a week ago / two weeks ago
a month ago / four months ago
a year ago / six years ago

Written A — Rewrite these sentences in the past tense

A Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句将以下句子改成过去时。
Example: She goes to town every day. → She went to town yesterday.

Rewrite each sentence in the past tense, following the example.

Written B — Write questions and answers

B Write questions and answers. 模仿例句提问并回答。
Example: look at that photograph/an hour ago → When did you look at that photograph? I looked at that photograph an hour ago.

Write a past-tense question and answer for each cue, following the example.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A — The simple past with irregular verbs (dialogues)

Look at this, then write dialogues like the example. Use the simple past tense. 看下表，模仿例句用一般过去时完成以下对话。
Verb: buy → Positive: he bought / Negative: he did not buy or he didn't buy / Question: did he buy? / Short answers: Yes, he did. or No, he didn't.

1. I / see that film / six months ago
A: I saw that film.
B: Oh, did you? When did you see it?
A: I saw it six months ago.

2. she / wear a dress like that / a week ago
3. John / go to Japan / three years ago
4. I / lose my passport once / about five years ago
5. my friends / meet a famous film star / two weeks ago

Write dialogues using the simple past tense with irregular verbs, following the example pattern.

The printed example (item 1) is not editable. Items 2-5 each require three answers (A statement, B question, A answer).

B — About you (personal questions with 'ago')

Write true answers to these questions. Try to use the word ago in your answers. 回答以下问题，争取使用 ago。

Answer each question truthfully, using the word 'ago' where possible.

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

I. Fill in the blanks with the past tense form of the verbs given. 用所给动词的过去式填空。

Fill in the blanks with the past tense form of the verbs given. 用所给动词的过去式填空。

The children ______ (leave) home last Saturday morning at nine o'clock. The bus ______ (go) very slowly, so they ______ (arrive) at the beach at about nine thirty. Some of them ______ (jump) into the sea and ______ (swim) happily. Some ______ (make) a fire and some ______ (bring) some wood. They ______ (cook) some food and ______ (eat) it quickly. They also ______ (drink) cold drinks. Then some of them ______ (play) on the sand, and others ______ (sleep). At four o'clock they ______ (catch) a bus home.

Fill in each blank with the correct past-tense form of the verb in brackets.

Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 507).

II. Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。

Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。

1. Did you buy a bike? → Yes, I did. When did you buy it? (last week) → I bought it last week. Did you buy a handbag, too? → No, I didn't.

2. Did you play football?
3. Did she go shopping?
4. Did he talk to the shop assistant?
5. Did they go to see a doctor?
6. Did the postman come?

Complete each dialogue with appropriate past-tense answers, following the example pattern.

Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-6 each require three answers (short answer, full answer with time, short answer to follow-up). Key: PDF viewer page 507.
